sentences.text: 4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor has raised objections against petitioner's prayer for interim bail.
It is submitted that the allegations are of grave nature and he is not entitled to interim bail.
5. It is also submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he had an extra marital affair with the informant.
As he was caught red handed along with the informant, the informant was compelled to lodge a false FIR against the petitioner.
It is further submitted that adultery is no more an offence.
6. The FIR unfolds that the petitioner attempted to commit rape on the victim who has lodged the FIR.
7. I have considered the submission that there was a delay in lodging the FIR.

It is also submitted on behalf of the petitioner that there was ample scope for fabrication as the incident allegedly occurred on 29.05.2024, but the FIR was lodged on 02.06.2024.
8.
I have also considered the submissions that the petitioner is willing to co- operate with the investigation and to abide by any stringent bail conditions.
9. It appears that there is a prima facie case to grant interim bail to the petitioner.

In the interim, and in the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs.
50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand) with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority under the condition that;
(i) the petitioner shall not exercise threats to the witnesses.
11. Call for the Case Diary.
12. List the matter on 19.08.2024.
